title: Sprint 1: Template schema and validation
description: Define the declarative work-structure template format and read-only CLI surface. Deliverables: JSON schema for template YAML files (metadata: id/version/variables; node tree: kind, title/description/labels/acceptance with {{var}} placeholders, gates, optional binding of workflow ref | md output contract | command; dependency edges); a templates location distinct from prose output contracts; bwrk template list, show, and validate commands. validate must reject unknown variables, unresolved {{var}} placeholders, invalid kinds, and dependency cycles.
acceptanceCriteria: Template schema file checked into schemas/ and documented
bwrk template list/show/validate work against a sample template file, with --json output
validate rejects unknown vars, bad kinds, and dep cycles with typed errors
Sprint closed with git checkpoint commit(s) or a no-commit reason code
closedReason: Template schema and validation implemented and verified.
